script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
If (each x in arg mapped to the value "no" of x) → index-of with (1) is at least 0, then
  If the register's 'battlePhase' is 1, then return false.
  Set the register's 'battlePhase' to 3.
  Let part be part 2 of the acting enemy.
  Part's 'statusAilments' → unset with (the INVISIBLE status).
  Part changes to stat block 210611036.
Return true.

yes.text: Let part be part 2 of the acting enemy.
